NAME: Persistent homology (persistence algorithm)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Multi-scale summary of connected components/holes of a filtration; persistence = feature significance
LIMITATIONS: Not a tracker; needs a filtration choice; no linking
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Basis for PH-02..PH-08

NAME: Cubical persistence on intensity (superlevel-set filtration)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Spot candidates as 0-dim persistence pairs; persistence as a contrast-like confidence; parameter-light peak detection
LIMITATIONS: Closely related to thresholding/peak finding; persistence ≈ peak prominence, so overlap with LoG/DoG scores is expected; no motion model
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P-PH detector arm (G08 §6), must beat LoG/DoG/Spotiflow at matched tuning

NAME: Stability of persistence diagrams
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Bottleneck-distance bound under bounded function perturbation ⇒ principled robustness of persistence scores to small noise
LIMITATIONS: Bound is in sup-norm; shot noise at low SNR is not small; stability ≠ identity preservation
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Justifies testing Δ-PH as a noise-robust confidence; not evidence of benefit

NAME: Relative / extended persistence
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Captures features relative to a subspace (e.g., boundary/background) and essential classes
LIMITATIONS: No verified imaging-tracking application found; adds complexity
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: OPTIONAL; not in core B0 (no verified tracking use)

NAME: Alpha complexes on detected point clouds
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Geometric filtration on point sets (e.g., spot coordinates per frame) for clustering/density structure
LIMITATIONS: Operates after detection; does not link identities
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Possible post-detection density/cluster feature for Δ; not a tracker

NAME: Vietoris–Rips filtrations (Ripser)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Rips PH on point clouds; used for tracking holes over time with Wasserstein matching (TDA_actomyosin code)
LIMITATIONS: Scales poorly with points; holes ≠ vesicles
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Not in core; prior art only

NAME: Persistence vineyards (time-varying persistence)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Continuous tracking of persistence pairs as the function evolves ⇒ candidate temporal Δ-PH (instability of a feature over frames)
LIMITATIONS: Vines can cross/swap under near-ties (identity ambiguity); assumes continuous change; frame rate dependent
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Δ-PH-V arm (G08 §6)

NAME: TOBLERONE (PH segmentation)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: PH-based segmentation for fluorescence images
LIMITATIONS: Segmentation of cells, not sub-resolution puncta; not compared to particle trackers on ISBI
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Prior art; optional segmenter arm only

NAME: 3D/temporal TOBLERONE
WHAT_IT_ADDS: PH segmentation with a temporal variant tracking cells/organelles; reports outperforming classical models on simulated data
LIMITATIONS: Self-reported; comparators are classical segmentation, not u-track/PDA; no verified ISBI particle metrics
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Strongest verified PH tracking prior art; include as PH pipeline arm if code is available, else UNVERIFIED availability

NAME: T-PEPT (topological particle tracking in PEPT)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: PH-based finding of multiple particles/tracks in high-noise data
LIMITATIONS: Different modality (positron emission), not microscopy
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Prior art for 'topological track detection'; not a B0 arm

NAME: TopoLoop (PH on trajectories)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: PH applied to already-tracked (x,y,z,t) trajectories for loop detection
LIMITATIONS: Post-tracking analysis; does not produce tracks
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Not a baseline; shows PH's verified niche is analysis after tracking

NAME: LoG spot detector (TrackMate)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Fast, standard sub-pixel spot detection with quality score
LIMITATIONS: Author-run assessment: fails below SNR≈2–3 (L2-124)
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Core detector in P1/P2; quality score = Δ-COST input

NAME: DoG spot detector (TrackMate)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Faster approximation of LoG for small spots
LIMITATIONS: Similar SNR limits
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Alternative detector; same tuning budget

NAME: Hessian detector (TrackMate)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Blob detection via Hessian determinant
LIMITATIONS: Accuracy not audited
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Optional detector

NAME: Spotiflow
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Deep spot detector for fluorescence; available in TrackMate
LIMITATIONS: Needs training data (DEV-generator only); domain shift to B1
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Core deep detector (P3); strongest a-priori detector candidate

NAME: Spot-detector comparison (Smal et al. 2010)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Shows detector choice materially affects results
LIMITATIONS: Rankings not audited here
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Justifies multi-detector panel

NAME: A-contrario detection/tracking
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Detection with explicit false-alarm control (relevant to HIGH_COST_FP)
LIMITATIONS: Preprint; implementation availability not verified
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Optional detector arm; strong non-PH competitor for FP control

NAME: StarDist
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Star-convex instance masks (nuclei/cells)
LIMITATIONS: Not designed for diffraction-limited puncta; using it as a spot baseline would be a strawman
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: NOT a primary vesicle baseline; only for resolved organelles in B1

NAME: Cellpose
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Generalist cell segmentation
LIMITATIONS: Same as SG-01
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: NOT a primary vesicle baseline

NAME: Hungarian / linear assignment
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Optimal frame-to-frame one-to-one association
LIMITATIONS: Only an association solver; costs and gating define behaviour
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Inside LAP/SORT; not a standalone baseline

NAME: LAP tracker (TrackMate, after Jaqaman 2008)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Frame linking + gap closing (+ merge/split options)
LIMITATIONS: Author-run assessment: best for Brownian vesicle scenario in TrackMate tests (L2-124), not independent
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Core linker (P1, P3, P-PH)

NAME: Kalman tracker (TrackMate linear motion)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Linear-motion prediction for directed transport
LIMITATIONS: Weak for Brownian/switching motion
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P2 linker; important for DIRECTED scenario

NAME: Nearest-neighbor / Overlap trackers (TrackMate)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Simple references
LIMITATIONS: Known weak at density; would be strawman as main baseline
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Lower-bound reference only, never the comparator for claims

NAME: u-track
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Detection + two-step LAP with gap closing, merging, splitting, motion models
LIMITATIONS: MATLAB; parameter-heavy
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Core strong baseline (P4)

NAME: u-track3D
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Modern dense-trajectory version with validation tools
LIMITATIONS: 3D-focused; 2D use to be checked
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P4 implementation choice

NAME: Piecewise-stationary motion model tracker
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Heterogeneous motion in dense environments
LIMITATIONS: Availability not verified
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Optional for MIXED scenario

NAME: Probabilistic data association (Godinez & Rohr)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Probabilistic association with motion models; group reports best overall at ISBI 2012 (self-report, L2-148)
LIMITATIONS: Implementation availability not verified
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Core strong baseline (P5) if available; strongest a-priori classical candidate

NAME: Kalman filter
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Optimal linear-Gaussian state estimation; posterior covariance usable as Δ-COST
LIMITATIONS: Linear-Gaussian assumptions
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Inside P2/SORT/PDA; posterior → Δ-COST

NAME: Particle filter (bootstrap)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Nonlinear/non-Gaussian state estimation; posterior spread usable as Δ
LIMITATIONS: Compute cost; particle degeneracy
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Inside P6

NAME: Particle filtering for fluorescence microscopy (Smal 2008)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Microscopy-specific PF tracking
LIMITATIONS: Availability not verified
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P6

NAME: Horn–Schunck optical flow
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Dense motion field as linking prior
LIMITATIONS: Brightness constancy violated by blinking/bleaching; sparse puncta
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P8 motion prior; expected weak, kept per ORDER §14

NAME: Deep probabilistic particle tracking (Spilger 2021)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Learned association with uncertainty
LIMITATIONS: Training data from DEV generator; availability to check
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P7

NAME: Trackastra
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Learned linking incl. fluorescent particle data
LIMITATIONS: Needs detections; training domain
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: P7 alternative linker on best detector

NAME: SORT
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Canonical tracking-by-detection baseline
LIMITATIONS: Designed for boxes/IoU; adapt to distance gating
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Reference TBD baseline from MOT literature

NAME: DeepSORT
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Appearance re-identification
LIMITATIONS: Puncta are nearly featureless ⇒ little gain expected
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Optional; not core

NAME: ByteTrack
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Uses low-confidence detections to reduce fragmentation (relevant to low SNR)
LIMITATIONS: Box/IoU origin
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Optional TBD comparator

NAME: TrackMate (platform)
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Hosts detectors (DT-01..04), segmenters (SG-01/02) and trackers (TR-02..04) — a platform, NOT an algorithm
LIMITATIONS: Results depend on chosen modules
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Implementation host for P1–P3, P-PH linking

NAME: ISBI 2012 particle tracking challenge
WHAT_IT_ADDS: Scenarios, SNR definition, metrics α/β/JSC/JSCθ/RMSE; no method best on all data
LIMITATIONS: Original data availability UNVERIFIED
FAIR_PIPELINE_ROLE: Design anchor for B0 and metric set
